assessment.nobel_worthiness: On public knowledge, the work has a highly distinctive voice: visionary, densely patterned prose in which memory, the body and cosmology become one metaphysical project. Blinding and Solenoid show formal ambition and sustained imaginative depth, and the writing also draws on his poetry. The strength is the coherence of a large inner world built through linguistic and structural invention.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on an expansive metaphysical, body-and-memory imagination expressed in Romanian prose, with poetry as a secondary strand. The single credited name is clear, and the scope fits the whole oeuvre rather than one book.
assessment.maturity: A long, sustained career with major late works, so the body of work looks mature and durable. Timing is not an obstacle.
uncertainties: My judgment of the Romanian prose style depends on translations, so I cannot independently verify the quality of the original language.
I have not read or verified the full corpus here, and the early poetry is less well known to me.
Some of the maximalist structures may divide readers, so the case needs close reading of the original.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The voice is exceptionally distinctive. Her hybrid forms (verse novel, essay, translation, elegy, object-book) remake the boundaries between classical scholarship, lyric and narrative. Autobiography of Red and Nox are widely regarded as formal achievements with real intellectual depth and emotional force. Her engagement with Greek antiquity is a sustained and original line of work.
assessment.attribution: The citation would cover formal innovation across poetry and essay, with classical reception as the intellectual ground. The credit belongs to a single author, though her translations and collaborative or visual projects complicate how the corpus is delimited.
assessment.maturity: Decades of consistent, inventive work with high sustained quality. The reception is mature, though whether the late work matches the early peaks is a fair question.
uncertainties: The genre-crossing work may be hard to classify under the will's wording, so the weight placed on the 'idealistic' direction needs discussion.
The translation and classical-scholarship component is hard to separate from original creation.
I cannot independently verify the claims about particular works, and some work is multimedia, which limits assessment of the text alone.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The poetic achievement is a remaking of modern Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and a long dialogue with inherited forms, as in Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses. The essays on tradition and modernity add intellectual depth. The influence on modern poetry in Arabic is large and the formal ambition is high.
assessment.attribution: The citation would center on the renewal of Arabic poetic form and language. The author identity is unambiguous, and the essays and critical work are closely tied to the poetic project.
assessment.maturity: A very long and consistent career whose importance has been established over decades. The question is whether the later work sustains the earlier level.
uncertainties: Much of the achievement lies in Arabic prosody and diction, and translations carry it only partially, so my assessment is limited.
The critical and political writing is influential, but it should not substitute for literary merit.
Coverage of the full corpus and of the later poetry is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A distinctive writing practice in Japanese and German turns linguistic estrangement into narrative and poetic form. The Emissary and Memoirs of a Polar Bear show inventive, playful intelligence and formal range across fiction, poetry, essay and drama. The bilingual practice is an actual literary method rather than a biographical feature.
assessment.attribution: The citation would cover bilingual writing and the use of estrangement as a form-making principle. The credit is to a single author who writes in two languages, so the corpus spans two literary traditions.
assessment.maturity: A substantial and still developing body of work, with the strongest case in the central fiction. The depth of the earlier poetry and drama is harder to gauge.
uncertainties: Quality in the two original languages is hard to judge through translation, particularly the wordplay.
Part of the corpus exists only in one language or in limited translation, so coverage is uncertain.
It is unclear whether the later works deepen or repeat the earlier method.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dense, compressed prose with strong linguistic intensity turns obscure lives and art history into narrative inquiry. Small Lives and The Eleven are recognized for style and for the way they combine biography, fiction and meditation on art. The achievement is very high in quality and economy, with a smaller scale of output.
assessment.attribution: The citation would cover a prose of exceptional compression that reinvents the biographical fiction. The author is unambiguous, and the work is closely tied to the French language.
assessment.maturity: A relatively small but sustained oeuvre with consistently high standards. Durability looks strong, though the narrow range of the corpus is a consideration.
uncertainties: The style depends on the French syntax and register, so translation makes judgment hard.
The size of the oeuvre is modest, and whether it is sufficient in breadth is a question for the committee.
I cannot verify the details of the more recent works.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences such as Purgatory and Anteparadise, together with landscape-scale interventions, turn suffering and historical violence into a collective memorial form. The project has a strong, singular voice and ambition and a clear place in Latin American poetry. The risk is that part of the achievement exists in non-textual or performative forms.
assessment.attribution: The citation would cover a poetry of memory and trauma that extends the lyric into collective and landscape forms. The author is clear, and the connection to a historical context is strong, though the literary merit must be judged separately from the political symbolism.
assessment.maturity: A long career with consistent aims and a stable reputation. The later work extends earlier themes, and whether it widens them is less clear to me.
uncertainties: Poetry in translation loses much, and the visual and typographic dimensions complicate assessment.
Some of the work is outside the printed book, so the textual corpus may understate or overstate the achievement.
Political and historical significance must not stand in for literary merit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike, uncompromising narrative worlds destabilize ordinary psychology, space and causal storytelling. Frontier and Love in the New Millennium represent a rigorous, unusual voice in Chinese fiction. The strength is the originality and consistency of the method; the main question is whether the intellectual depth develops enough across the oeuvre.
assessment.attribution: The citation would cover radical experimental fiction that dissolves conventional realism. The credit is to a single author and the scope is coherent, centered on fiction and criticism.
assessment.maturity: A long, consistent career, with the reception growing over time. Whether the work evolves beyond its core strategy is uncertain.
uncertainties: Reliance on translations makes it hard to judge the language itself.
A strongly consistent method can be read as depth or as repetition, and I have not read enough to decide.
The corpus is large and only part is available in translation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Encyclopedic fiction links systems of power, science and countercultural imagination. Gravity's Rainbow and Mason & Dixon show exceptional linguistic range, formal invention and intellectual ambition, and have been very influential on postwar fiction in English. The achievement is large, though some later novels are more uneven in reception.
assessment.attribution: The citation would cover encyclopedic, systems-oriented fiction and its comic and paranoid registers. The author identity is unambiguous, though the private public profile means little biographical context is available.
assessment.maturity: A long and mature oeuvre with a durable core. The timing question is whether the late work adds to the case.
uncertainties: The unevenness of the later novels affects the judgment of sustained quality.
The dense references and the humor are demanding and may not travel well in translation.
I cannot verify the details of recent publications independently.
